analysis.summary: Customer has a burst main pipe under the kitchen sink with water flooding into hallway. Requires urgent immediate emergency callout.

structuredData.issue_description: Burst pipe under kitchen sink flooding ground floor

message.transcript:
Assistant: Hello, thanks for calling Romford Emergency Plumbing & Heating. Debbie speaking. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hello, I have an urgent emergency! My main pipe under the kitchen sink has burst and water is pouring all over the floor!
Assistant: Oh dear, don't worry Mr. Miller. Can I confirm your postcode in Romford?
Customer: It's RM1 4AU, near Romford station.
Assistant: Got that. Turn off your stopcock if you can. I am paging our emergency engineer directly right now, he will call you back in five minutes.
